scenarios.invariant: A persisted continue decision admits its deterministic input exactly once after recovery.
An admitted pending input survives restart and is promoted once.
Duplicate advisory wakes do not duplicate provider work or SessionInput rows.
Real user steer and queue inputs precede automatic queue work and begin a new chain.
A 15-second supervisor timeout persists defer and returns control without automatic continuation.
Malformed supervisor output persists defer without heuristic guessing or automatic continuation.
Provider retries are finite and remain visible in trace classification.
Non-retryable provider failures stop immediately and count as task failures.
The persisted chain never admits continuation maxRuns + 1.
